description:
Touring just got Electrified.
Color: Flame On | True Blue

Equipped with Bosch e-assist

With a whisper quiet motor capable of 75Nm of torque, this system is wickedly fun. Go from the “all-day ride” Eco mode to an exhilarating Turbo mode with a few clicks of a button on your Smart LED Remote.

The Bosch Smart System ushers in the digital eBike future by fully connecting the eBike Flow app with all eBike components. This allows for over-the-air updates and continuous new functions, like navigation and enhanced theft protection, keeping your eBike current and your riding experience personalized.

The Gran Tourismo is alluringly sophisticated with exhilarating performance resulting in the ultimate touring machine. With a nod to the original Tour, the GT is the culmination of over 20 years of continuous innovation and customer feedback, resulting in the most comfortable and best handling TerraTrike to date!

The Y-frame design adds strength while allowing for additional heel clearance and ease in getting in and out. The new triangulated rear end adds pedaling efficiency, better aerodynamics, reduced pedal steer and lower center of gravity so that you “stick” to the road even at higher speeds. The GT also comes standard with a 24” rear wheel for higher top-end speeds, smoother rolling over bumps and retaining momentum. The Gran Tourismo also features an extended seat frame with an upgraded seat mesh, contoured to give additional support and comfort and padded in “all the right places!”

The Gran Tourismo is the perfect trike for a cross-country adventure, your daily commute or a leisurely trail ride to your favorite destination.

*Please note - This TerraTrike comes equipped with our Comfort Pedal Conversion Kit!

The Battery Network – Bosch Battery Fee
Please note: a $15 recycling fee will be added to the price of every Bosch product with the new Smart System. This program provides support for battery recycling to riders like you! Learn more about the initiative here: batterynetwork.org
